costPerDose.rationale: About 2x the $9.61 planned bundle/target-dose benchmark, rounded, allowing extra outreach effort and delivery shortfalls. Not an SFAF quote.

sources.title: Proposed SFAF agreement 1000032060

marginalYieldRetention.rationale: Aggregate judgment for harder-to-reach expansion, displacement, reporting mismatch and repeat recipients in a heavily supplied SF market.

additionalSurvivalPerReversal.rationale: Credits one additional acute survivor per 50 retained reported reversals; spontaneous survival and alternative rescue are common in SF.
